attrs.evidence: trvm_world.mjs L-MAINT-2 (the no-op pass proven, not asserted); grid_check v2.9 recomputes the commitment and performs the full before+steps=after reconstruction engine-free on the shipped maintenance_receipt.json; the maintenance receipt is deterministic across identical runs.
attrs.statement: The MaintenanceReceipt PROVES the pass rather than narrating it: the BEFORE and AFTER publication maps and the ordered steps are committed (pass_id = H('TRVM-MAINTPASS-v1' | vclocks | before | after | steps)), and AFTER must be reconstructible from BEFORE + steps by arithmetic — none/quarantined steps preserve ids and versions, refreshed/rederived steps advance the publication version and change the warrant_id. A converged pass is a receipted NO-OP: all-none steps, vclock unmoved, before == after.
